# Move DOWN to cover remaining green pixels
# White at rows 11-28, green at rows 14-34
# Move DOWN by 3 to cover rows 14-31 with white

ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("After 3 DOWN:")
for r in range(10, 38):
    line = ascii[r][35:55]
    if any(c in line for c in 'WNR'):
        print(f"  {r}: {line}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_pixels = sum(n['pixels'] for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
print(f"\nGreen pixels: {green_pixels}")
print("Level completed:", last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
